review_scope: Full before/after text, supplied benchmark context, official evidence, actual parent and whole-grid witness scope inspected. Examples are illustrative and outcome-selected/fixed, not prevalence estimates.

findings.selection: Judge ranks the intermediate 75 first after selection, although 75 was already in the parent and the new ceil equation is false. Do not call this a new correct calculation.
findings.consensus: The useful intermediate 7 is removed from the only passing site, while generic reasoning preambles remain. The parent also mislabeled 7 as final; recovered number does not imply fully correct prose.
findings.pruning: Deleting the wrong compound and temperature assertion changes the local verdict to consistent. Remaining prose has no sodium nitrite or requested value and has no supported-true claim in the retained stage-two tally.
findings.pooling: Correct role direction becomes prominent, but it already appeared among conflicting parent bullets. The child keeps conflicting directions and invents cereal/candy/toys/exhaustion. Official recovery improves, full faithfulness is not established.
findings.verification: Required Adwa bridge appears; wrong or uncertain generals remain. This observed bridge gain alone does not establish control-based activation specificity.
findings.combinations: Pruning removes the Enkidu-bearing bullet at a fixed anchor, while Humbaba survives. Two other sites preserve the whole-question pass; this is local loss, not a whole-question regression.

limits: Final deck examples must retain exact source text and resolve against source-pinned qualitative packs; final score overlap must be checked before final reuse.
